blocks.text: ILIGAN CITY — The Iligan City Police Office is verifying allegations of police surveillance and intimidation of students during a Nov. 17 campus mobilization at Mindanao State University-Iligan Institute of Technology (MSU-IIT) against the US-led Pax Silica Initiative and US President Donald Trump’s state visit to Manila. In a statement posted on its social media page, the Iligan police said it was taking seriously reports about the alleged presence of police agents suspected of conducting intelligence activities inside the university premises. The Kabataan Partylist Iligan City Chapter alleged that students documented an Iligan City Police Mobile vehicle with two police personnel […]...
